title: Best NFL Draft fits for the Bengals at linebacker

sources.title: Best NFL Draft fits for the Bengals at linebacker
sources.description: Like it or not, the Cincinnati Bengals are not ready to give up on their second-year linebackers Barrett Carter and Demetrius Knight. The pair have been praised vociferously by the coaching staff for how well they performed despite the lack of a veteran on the field at the position. Carter replaced veteran Logan Wilson mid-season […]
